column1: # Selection-scorer smoke (2026-10-18; analysis/selection-scorer.md): scripted mockllm agents (scripts/smoke_v7b.py), no model spend, rows as in plans/v7b-smoke.tsv. Group r1 is a team of 4 and an independent, group r2 an independent; with --max-agents 5, r2 starts only when an r1 row has ended, so r1 is selected on the selection scorer while r2's agent works on the agent scorer. Run: SEED_OFFSET_FILE=<main's data/.algotune_seed_offset.v7> EXPERIMENT=v7 HOURS=4 SCORER_MACHINE=c7a.8xlarge scripts/v6.sh plans/v7-selscorer-smoke.tsv 1000000000 selscorer --group-start --validity-n 20 --script scripts/smoke_v7b.py --max-agents 5 (analysis/selection-scorer/aws_smoke.sh)
